digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync command and rebar reconciler CLI
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass without launching reconcile-check or duplicating comparison.
Canonical bridge preview must remain lock-free, acquiring, purging, stealing, or writing no pass locks, while preserving collateral repository and reference state unchanged.
Legacy reconcile-check must retain all-cached-ticket loading, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and exact output/exit behavior unchanged.

Argparse must set allow_abbrev=False to reject abbreviated or unknown options with invocation error 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers preserve historical tally-only/no-manifest surface.
Existing capped canonical sync and legacy bootstrap applied/deferred partitions must remain deterministic and unchanged.
